entry.title: [WATCH] runc - security update
entry.summary: [WATCH] Several vulnerabilities were discovered in runc, the Open Container Initiative runtime. Depending on the configuration, exploitation could expose host resources, cause a denial of service, or permit container escape. https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/DSA-6656-1 Debian stable. Run apt update and apt upgrade, then reboot if the kernel changed. Source: https://lists.debian.org/debian-security-announce/2026/msg00578.html
